svg.aria-label: Placing the top electrode and spring: place the top spacer on the film, aligned with the bottom spacer, then place the spring in the center. For Li symmetric and SS | Li cells, press a Li foil onto the top spacer, Li side down facing the film. If the top and bottom spacers are misaligned, the effective area is less than A.
